# Processed Content

## Text
clean_text: ```
```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<report>
  <metadata>
    <title>Quarterly Business Report</title>
    <period>
      <quarter>Q4</quarter>
      <year>2025</year>
    </period>
    <document_type>Business Report</document_type>
  </metadata>

  <section id="executive-summary">
    <heading level="2">Executive Summary</heading>
    <content>
      <financial_performance>
        <metric name="revenue">
          <value currency="USD" unit="billion">4.2</value>
          <change type="year-over-year" direction="increase" unit="percent">15</change>
          <drivers>
            <driver>cloud services</driver>
            <driver>enterprise software</driver>
          </drivers>
        </metric>

        <metric name="operating_margin">
          <value unit="percent">28</value>
          <change type="quarter-over-quarter" direction="increase" unit="percent">4</change>
          <comparison>
            <prior_period>Q3</prior_period>
            <prior_value unit="percent">24</prior_value>
          </comparison>
        </metric>

        <metric name="customer_acquisition_cost">
          <change type="period" direction="decrease" unit="percent">12</change>
          <attribution>improved marketing efficiency</attribution>
        </metric>
      </financial_performance>

      <market_expansion>
        <description>The company expanded into three new markets.</description>
        <markets>
          <market region="Asia">Southeast Asia</market>
          <market region="Europe">Eastern Europe</market>
          <market region="Americas">South America</market>
        </markets>
      </market_expansion>
    </content>
  </section>

  <section id="key-metrics">
    <heading level="2">Key Metrics</heading>
    <content>
      <operational_metrics>
        <metric name="active_users">
          <value unit="million">45</value>
          <change type="period" direction="increase" unit="percent">22</change>
        </metric>

        <metric name="monthly_recurring_revenue">
          <value currency="USD" unit="million">350</value>
        </metric>

        <metric name="net_promoter_score">
          <value>71</value>
          <change type="period" direction="increase">
            <prior_value>62</prior_value>
          </change>
        </metric>
      </operational_metrics>

      <organizational_metrics>
        <metric name="employee_headcount">
          <value>8500</value>
          <distribution>
            <offices count="12" scope="global"/>
          </distribution>
        </metric>

        <metric name="rd_investment">
          <value currency="USD" unit="million">840</value>
          <value_as_percent_of_revenue unit="percent">20</value_as_percent_of_revenue>
        </metric>
      </organizational_metrics>
    </content>
  </section>

  <section id="outlook">
    <heading level="2">Outlook</heading>
    <content>
      <forecast>
        <period>
          <quarter>Q1</quarter>
          <year>2026</year>
        </period>
        <revenue_guidance>
          <range currency="USD" unit="billion">
            <low>4.4</low>
            <high>4.6</high>
          </range>
        </revenue_guidance>
      </forecast>

      <initiatives>
        <initiative id="1" category="product_launch">
          Launching the AI-powered analytics platform
        </initiative>
        <initiative id="2" category="ecosystem_growth">
          Expanding the partner ecosystem
        </initiative>
        <initiative id="3" category="compliance">
          Achieving SOC 2 Type II certification for all cloud products
        </initiative>
      </initiatives>
    </content>
  </section>
</report>
```

### Tagging Decisions

| Choice | Rationale |
|---|---|
| `<metadata>` block | Separates document-level information from content |
| `<metric>` with `name` attribute | Enables consistent querying of all metrics across sections |
| `<change>` with `direction` and `type` | Distinguishes YoY vs QoQ comparisons and increase/decrease explicitly |
| `<financial_performance>` vs `<operational_metrics>` | Groups metrics by domain for easier targeted parsing |
| `<initiative>` with `category` attribute | Allows filtering initiatives by type (compliance, product, growth) |
| Numeric values isolated from units | Keeps values machine-readable without requiring string parsing |
```
